actions.expr:
CFLOAT(EVALUATE(' var cost = input.arg1;  return cost.toFixed(2); ', 
(
NUMBER(bladeWeight)
*
NUMBER(frameMaterialCost)
*
(1+
(
CFLOAT(
OBJECTATTRIBUTEV(countryWiseCost,'$[Blade Wastage (ULRD)]','cost')
)))
)
)
)

NUMBER(bladeSealInputValue)*  
CFLOAT(OBJECTATTRIBUTEV(countryWiseCost,'$[UL FNST Blade Seal - High Temperature]','cost'))

CFLOAT(OBJECTATTRIBUTEV(countryWiseCost,'$[Zeb Drive Pin Steel 15.87X21.46mm 9146]','cost'))
+
CFLOAT(OBJECTATTRIBUTEV(countryWiseCost,'$[Jack Shaft Drive GI G90 110X25mm 9008]','cost'))
+
CFLOAT(OBJECTATTRIBUTEV(countryWiseCost,'$[5/16 - 18 x 1 1/2 Carriage Bolt]','cost'))
+
CFLOAT(OBJECTATTRIBUTEV(countryWiseCost,'$[5/16 -18 Flange Whiz Nut]','cost'))
+
CFLOAT(OBJECTATTRIBUTEV(countryWiseCost,'$[1/4 - 20 Lock Nut]','cost'))
+
CFLOAT(OBJECTATTRIBUTEV(countryWiseCost,'$[Zeb Drive Link CRS 12.7X150mm 9006]','cost'))

NUMBER(jackShaftKitUnitCost)
+
CFLOAT(OBJECTATTRIBUTEV(countryWiseCost,'$[Jack Shaft Drive GI G90 110X25mm 9008]','cost'))
+
CFLOAT(OBJECTATTRIBUTEV(countryWiseCost,'$[Fuse Link Retainer Pin]','cost'))
+
CFLOAT(OBJECTATTRIBUTEV(countryWiseCost,'$[Fuse Link Hexa Stud Pin Steel 11X30.6mm 9145]','cost'))
+
CFLOAT(OBJECTATTRIBUTEV(countryWiseCost,'$[Spring Retainer Bushing Steel 31.75mmX6.35mmDia]','cost'))
+
CFLOAT(OBJECTATTRIBUTEV(countryWiseCost,'$[Damper Closer Spring SS304 55.5mmX3.2mmDia]','cost'))
+
CFLOAT(OBJECTATTRIBUTEV(countryWiseCost,'$[3/16 Inch x 2 Inch Lg. Solid Roll Pin]','cost'))

IIF(CONTAINS(transitionType,'$[NA]'),0,(
IIF(NUMBER(diameter) > NUMBER(transitionDiameter),NUMBER(diameter),NUMBER(transitionDiameter))
*
(NUMBER(transitionLength)
/1000000  )
+
IIF(
CONTAINS(transitionType,'$[Both Sides]'),
    (
    IIF(
        NUMBER(diameter) > NUMBER(transitionDiameter2),NUMBER(diameter),NUMBER(transitionDiameter2)
        )
*
NUMBER(transitionLength2)/1000000
),0) ))

NUMBER(junctionBoxValue)*
 (
    CFLOAT(OBJECTATTRIBUTEV(countryWiseCost,'$[2 Way Junction Box with Cover 100x50x48-Ul Listed]','cost'))  +
    CFLOAT(OBJECTATTRIBUTEV(countryWiseCost,'$[Twister Wire Connector]','cost'))
 )

CFLOAT(EVALUATE(' var cost = input.arg1;  return cost.toFixed(2); ', 
NUMBER(totalMaterialCostBeforeMotors)+NUMBER(fuseLinkCost)+NUMBER(mtsCost)+NUMBER(junctionBoxCost)+NUMBER(actuatorCost)))

IIF(
CONTAINS(transitionType,'$[NA]'),0,
(IIF(CONTAINS(transitionType,'$[One Side]'),1,2))
)
*
CFLOAT
(
    OBJECTATTRIBUTEV(countryWiseCost,'$[Transition Time per m of Perimeter of Damper (ULRD)]','cost')
)

CFLOAT(EVALUATE(' var cost = input.arg1; return cost.toFixed(2); ', 

((NUMBER(totalMaterialCostWithMotors)+NUMBER(totalAssemblyCost) - NUMBER(actuatorCost))
*
CFLOAT(OBJECTATTRIBUTEV(countryWiseCost,'$[Overhead Percentage (ULRD)]','cost')))
+
(NUMBER(actuatorCost)
*
CFLOAT(
OBJECTATTRIBUTEV(countryWiseCost,'$[Overhead Percentage on Actuator (ULRD)]','cost')
))
))

CONCAT(
IIF((NUMBER(diameter) > 0), CONCAT( 'D:' , NUMBER(diameter)) , ''),
IIF((NUMBER(frameDepth) > 0), CONCAT( ' L:' , NUMBER(frameDepth)) , ''),
IIF((COUNT(frameMaterialType) > 0), CONCAT( ' - ' ,SELECTEDVALUE(frameMaterialType),' ') , ''),
EVALUATE(' var mNo = input.arg1; return mNo.replace(" - Static","")',IIF((COUNT(modelDescription)>0),SELECTEDVALUE(modelDescription),''))
)
